mood: Hacker terminal meets premium Vercel/Linear aesthetic. Dense, precise, high-performance command center. Left-aligned asymmetry. No AI slop.

layout.spacing_system: Generous spacing for macro sections (p-12, py-24), dense spacing for data tables (p-3, p-4)
layout.corners: rounded-md (max 6px radius for sharp, technical feel)
layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Protocol: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4
layout.alignment: Left-aligned asymmetry. Center nothing unless it's an empty state.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (#0A0A0A), 1px solid border (#262626), no shadow by default. Hover adds subtle -translate-y-0.5 and border color shift.
surfaces.headers: Solid background with hard bottom border border-[#262626]
surfaces.kanban_board: Columns have distinct dark grey bg (#121212) with 1px border (#262626).

rules: Staggered entrance for lists and table rows.
Hover states must alter border color to cyan/blue and slight text brightening.
Tracing beam or border gradient animation for active AI Agents.
Keep durations short (0.2s) to maintain the fast, high-performance command center feel.

components_strategy.buttons: Flat backgrounds, sharp edges. Primary CTA uses neon border/text or subtle glowing background.
components_strategy.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn table. Monospace fonts for IDs, dates, and metrics.
components_strategy.forms: Left-aligned labels, Shadcn inputs with dark backgrounds, glow on focus focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts) using dark mode palette, cyan and purple lines. Hide grid lines or make them extremely faint (#262626).

image_urls.description: Abstract flowing shape with purple and blue highlights - Use for Login/Register split screen right side background. Use max bg-black/40 overlay.
Abstract metallic sculpture with iridescent blue and purple hues - Use for Empty States or large visual sections
Abstract purple metallic knot - Use as the visual avatar or state indicator for AI agent instances

icons.style: Use regular or duotone weight for a dense developer tools look.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-campaign-button'). Use kebab-case, role-based naming.

page_specific_instructions.login_register: Split screen layout. Left side: Form. Right side: Image category 'hero_abstract_bg' with an overlay of bg-black/30. Use Shadcn forms but highly customized with sharp borders.
page_specific_instructions.dashboard: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-4). Metric cards at the top using JetBrains Mono for numbers. Left-aligned charts. Dense and data-rich.
page_specific_instructions.campaign_builder: Multi-step visual. Use sharp, tech-style cards. Tracing beam border (via framer-motion) for active/selected step.
page_specific_instructions.leads_crm: Dense table view + Kanban board. Kanban columns should have a distinct dark grey background with 1px borders.
page_specific_instructions.ai_composer: Modal using Glassmorphism overlay. Text area should have subtle purple glow when 'AI generating' is active.
page_specific_instructions.agents_page: Live status page. Use Framer motion to create a 'pulse' effect on active agents. Monospace logs.
page_specific_instructions.analytics: Dense charts. Accent colors (cyan/purple) on dark background.
page_specific_instructions.settings: Standard list-based form layout. Clean, left-aligned, high contrast. Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layout, Shadcn logic for inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts: Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn borders everywhere, override border colors to #262626.
Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes APCA contrast. Never use muddy gradients on white.
Implement 'data-testid' on all CTAs and interactive items.
Use Framer Motion for micro-interactions but avoid slow transitions (use duration 0.2s).
Build the UI in React (.jsx or .js) with Tailwind CSS.
When customizing Shadcn components, respect the sharp aesthetics (rounded-md max) and dark premium feel.
